title: Balochistan Civil Servants Second Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Civil Servants Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE LII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
CIVIL SERVANTS
(SECOND
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE
LII OF 2001
An
Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 10th December, 2001]
No.
Legis.l-12/Law/73-II, dated 10-12-2001. The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 4th December, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short
title and commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Balochistan Civil Servants (Second Amendment) Ordinance,.2001.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

Legis.l-12/Law/73-II, dated 10-12-2001. The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 4th December, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:--
2. Amendment
of section 13 of Act IX of 1974.---In the
Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974, in clause (i) of subsection (1) of
section 13, for the words "twenty five" the word "twenty"
shall be substituted.
